title: Bulk room setup wizard
description: Quick-add flow to create N rooms of a given type/price on a floor in one pass, instead of one at a time.
acceptanceCriteria: Warden can specify a count and type and get N rooms created at once
Each generated room gets correctly numbered and its beds created

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Last Todo ticket in the backlog. Built BulkRoomFormViewModel/BulkRoomFormScreen (ui/property/), reachable via a new top-bar action icon on RoomListScreen next to the existing single-room FAB. Numbering scheme (not specified by the ticket or DESIGN.md): warden gives a numeric starting room number and a count N; rooms are created as (start), (start+1), ... (start+N-1) - e.g. 101 + 5 rooms -> 101..105 - stated explicitly in a hint under the field so the warden isn't guessing at the scheme (AC1). Each iteration reuses RoomFormViewModel's exact create-then-generate-beds sequence (roomRepository.create then bedRepository.generateForRoom with the same SINGLE/DOUBLE/TRIPLE->1/2/3 bed-count mapping RoomFormViewModel already uses), so every generated room gets the right number of correctly-labeled (A, B, C...) beds, same as creating them one at a time (AC2). No duplicate-room-number check was added, matching RoomFormScreen's existing single-add behavior (roomNumber was never unique-constrained anywhere in the schema or the one-at-a-time form) - not introducing stricter validation here than already exists elsewhere. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. On-device pass still blocked (session-wide emulator limitation) - worth confirming the generated rooms/beds actually show up correctly in RoomListScreen/BedGridScreen right after a bulk save, not just that the repository calls look right on paper. This was the last remaining Todo ticket on the board - everything else is now at least in Testing.
